outcome: Use of unhealthy food preparation methods
cohort: 212 pregnant women (117 Italian and 95 immigrant) who underwent an oral glucose tolerance test in three hospitals in Tuscany Region, Central Italy
finding: Immigrant women showed lower adherence to the prudent diet compared to Italian women and a broader use of unhealthy food preparation, but there were no statistical differences in primary maternal and neonatal outcomes between GDM and NGT cohorts.
